snippet.title: Colony 37 - Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
Early access trailer for my upcoming game called Colony 37.
It's a mining game where you must dig down to uncover planet's secrets, collecting valuable loot and upgrading your gear in the progress.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3869630/Colony_37/

#exploration #game #earlyaccess #trailer #horror #mining #digging #steam
